title: Regulated-Scope Figure — Insurance Claim Services Pricing Clause
content:
**Clause.** For an Insurance Claim Services regulated-scope supplement, the regulated-scope figure is the total of the regulated lines the supplement carries, every line taken from the lines billed on the Water Damage Mitigation job at the amount billed, and it is rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure. The figure carries the lead-safe setup lines and the asbestos sampling lines billed on the water job, at the amount billed.

**Rounding.** Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added to the total before it is rounded, so that a total lying on a half cent always rounds up. Nothing is rounded line by line.

## Lines read from the water job

| Line billed on the water job | Taken at |
|---|---|
| lead-safe setup | the amount billed |
| asbestos sampling | the amount billed |

## Worked figure (hypothetical lines)

| Line | Amount billed |
|---|---|
| lead-safe setup | 318.45 |
| asbestos sampling | 506.12 |

Total 824.57, rounded once, half up: **824.57**. A job that billed a lead-safe setup line of 318.45 and no asbestos sampling line gives 318.45; a job that billed neither gives 0.00.
